description: React component for user theme settings in Mattermost, allowing users to select, customize, and apply themes with options for all teams and custom themes.

classes.name: ThemeSetting
classes.description: React component for managing user theme settings, including theme selection, customization, and application.

methods.name: getStateFromProps
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props, setting default theme if not provided.

methods.name: focusEditButton
methods.description: Focuses the minimum settings UI element.

methods.name: submitTheme
methods.description: Saves the selected theme, optionally applies to all teams, and updates component state.

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Updates the theme in state and applies it immediately.

methods.name: updateType
methods.description: Updates the theme type (premade or custom).

methods.name: resetFields
methods.description: Resets theme fields to initial values and reapplies the theme.

methods.name: handleUpdateSection
methods.description: Handles section updates in the parent component.
